axes.xDefinition: log10 total stellar mass of the galaxy (galaxy finder)
axes.yDefinition: log10 mean specific star formation rate (axis in Gyr^-1, converted to yr^-1)

selection.warning: Mean sSFR of Horizon-AGN galaxies at z=0.3, read from the vector path of Dubois et al. 2016 (the error bars of the mean and the Karim+11 points are not extracted). AGN feedback creates a population of passive massive galaxies, absent without AGN.

provenance.citation: Dubois et al. 2016, MNRAS 463, 3948 (arXiv:1606.03086), mean sSFR as a function of stellar mass at z=0.3
provenance.figure: Mean sSFR versus galaxy stellar mass for Horizon-AGN (solid) and Horizon-noAGN (dashed) at z=0.3
provenance.extractionMethod: vector path vertices from the figure PDF (PyMuPDF get_drawings), transformed through axes calibrated on labelled tick marks
provenance.axisCalibrationPixels: x and y: major ticks (longer strokes) assigned the labels read from the rendered figure (glyph paths): x 9-13 in log10 M, y 0.001, 0.01, 0.1 Gyr^-1 (log); y converted to yr^-1 by subtracting 9 dex

records.notes: Vector-path extraction; exact to PDF coordinate precision, so uncertainty is the plotted line, not marker tracing.
